T: All he wanted was something to eat.
D: A drifting Vietnam veteran gets run out of a small Washington town, and the sheriff keeps pushing until the woods push back.
P: Carve the wild hog when Rambo spears his supper in the woods.
S: Hope woods pan trout with brown butter and almonds
Rambo lives off the land in the Hope woods

Pat the trout dry, season and dust the skin side with the flour. Fry skin side down in the hot oil until the skin is crisp, then flip for a minute and lift onto plates. Add the butter and almonds to the pan and cook until the butter smells nutty and the almonds are golden. Squeeze in the lemon, add the parsley and spoon over the trout.
4 small rainbow trout fillets, skin on@Seafood
Smoked salmon and corn chowder in tin mugs

Melt the butter and soften the onion and celery. Stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and cream. Add the potatoes and corn and simmer until the potatoes are tender. Flake in the salmon, warm through, season with pepper and scatter with dill. Ladle into tin mugs and serve hot.
Highway diner patty melts on rye
The diner thirty miles up the highway

Cook the onions slowly in half the butter with a pinch of salt until soft and brown. Shape the mince into 4 thin patties the size of the bread, season with salt, pepper and paprika, and sear hard for 2 minutes a side. Butter the outside of the bread, then build each melt: cheese, patty, onions, mustard, cheese. Griddle the melts over medium heat, pressing down, until the bread is crisp and the cheese runs, then cut each into quarters.
M: Knife-spear wild hog with charred apples and cider jus
Rambo spears a wild hog for supper

Rub the pork all over with salt, the paprika, sugar and fennel, keeping the skin dry. Roast on a rack at 240C for 30 minutes to blister the skin, then turn down to 160C. Slow roast until a fork twists the meat easily, adding the apples and onions to the tray for the last 40 minutes. Rest the pork, then put the tray on the stove, add the cider and stock and boil, scraping, until syrupy. Meanwhile boil the potatoes, then mash with the butter and milk. Pull the pork into chunks and serve on the mash with the charred apples, onions and jus.
1.8kg boneless pork shoulder (or wild boar), skin scored@Meat
W: The gas station goes up in flames

Mix the crushed biscuits with the melted butter and salt and toast in a dry pan until golden. Warm the cream in a small cast-iron pan, take it off the heat and stir in the chocolate until smooth. Pack the marshmallows over the chocolate and grill or blowtorch until blackened in spots. Scatter the crumbs over and serve straight from the pan with spoons.
K: First-light camp coffee with bourbon and maple
Come first light, every man on the ridge

Whip the cream with a tablespoon of the maple syrup until just thick. Stir the bourbon and the rest of the maple into the hot coffee and pour into 4 enamel mugs. Float the maple cream on top and drizzle with a little more maple.
2 tbsp maple syrup, plus extra to serve@Pantry

veg.n: Smoky corn chowder in tin mugs (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Make up to a day ahead and reheat gently; add the dill to serve

Melt the butter and soften the onion and celery, then stir in the flour and paprika.
Whisk in the stock and cream, add the potatoes and the rest of the corn and simmer until tender.
Season, top with the charred corn and dill, and serve in tin mugs.

Fry the mushrooms hard with the paprika in another knob of butter until dark.
Butter the bread, build with cheese, mushrooms, onions, mustard and cheese, and griddle until crisp and melting.

dishes.n: Knife-spear wild hog with charred apples and cider jus

steps.text: Rub the cabbage wedges with the oil, paprika, fennel and salt and roast at 220C with the apples and onions, turning once.
Boil the potatoes, then mash with the butter and milk.
Put the tray on the stove, add the cider and stock and boil, scraping, until syrupy, then serve over the cabbage.
